description: The submitted mapping cannot be executed.
resolution: Correct the named mechanical issue without changing unrelated mappings.

description: A substantively rich workbook was mapped mostly to parent or no-value decisions.
resolution: Map identifiable child accounts from the routed financial detail.

description: A COA parent is missing its required decision.
resolution: Add a supported mapping or no_value decision and declare child coverage.

description: A complete parent does not equal its immediate children.
resolution: Find omitted misplaced or overlapping detail without inventing values.

description: A partial hierarchy with a residual does not reconcile.
resolution: Map supported siblings and use only the legitimate residual.

description: A parent marked not present has active children.
resolution: Correct the children or the coverage declaration.

description: A parent has no explicit child coverage state.
resolution: Set coverage from the source structure.

description: A blank parent has populated children.
resolution: Map the supported parent or remove children that do not belong.

description: Summary and independently mapped department amounts do not reconcile.
resolution: Check scope periods schedules offsets and source hierarchy.

description: Independent supported source layers still differ.
resolution: Preserve both source values and disclose the difference.

description: A selected layer differs from a typed alternate layer.
resolution: Preserve the supported selection and its cited comparison.

description: A reported source subtotal differs from its cited components.
resolution: Review the source arithmetic without changing the mapped values automatically.

description: A cited source subtotal cannot be checked in this period.
resolution: Inspect the missing source values without assuming zero.

description: A typed selected layer does not reproduce its mapped target.
resolution: Correct the operations and cited row sets.

description: An equivalent row supplies a period the selected row leaves blank.
resolution: Use the period-complete row or complementary non-overlapping rows.

description: A proven combined source presentation differs from standard categories.
resolution: Preserve the operator Summary and separate detailed categories.

description: The declared combined OOD and miscellaneous presentation does not reconcile.
resolution: Confirm the presentation mode and check detailed omissions or duplication.

description: A combined OOD and miscellaneous presentation populates both Summary buckets.
resolution: Put the combined amount only in the selected Summary bucket.

description: A Summary subtotal fails its required equation.
resolution: Check missing duplicated or incorrectly signed Summary lines.

description: A reported KPI differs from its deterministic calculation.
resolution: Check KPI units and mapped room or revenue inputs.

description: Reported occupancy exceeds 100 percent.
resolution: Review the cited room counts and occupancy; do not cap the source value.

description: Rooms sold is positive but available room nights is zero or negative.
resolution: Review the source capacity and period; do not invent room availability.

description: A named non-residual leaf was calculated as its parent less its siblings.
resolution: Use the directly identified source row or leave unsupported detail blank.

description: Non-operating income has the wrong normalized sign.
resolution: Apply the supported Standard COA sign convention.

description: A source row occurs more than once in one calculation.
resolution: Remove the duplicate occurrence.

description: One calculation both includes and excludes the same row.
resolution: Keep the row only on the required side.

description: A source row is assigned to unrelated accounts.
resolution: Choose one valid account or non-overlapping detail.

description: Supported reported values differ slightly.
resolution: Preserve both reported values and disclose the difference.

description: The source supports a parent and only some child detail.
resolution: Preserve the parent and map every identifiable child.

description: A material residual is calculated rather than directly supported.
resolution: Prefer identifiable rows or disclose the retained remainder.

description: A material difference was assigned to a residual for final presentation.
resolution: Review the residual and preserve supported values.

description: A material negative remainder was not forced into a residual.
resolution: Check duplicates offsets signs and already-netted amounts.

description: Two materially different mappings remain plausible.
resolution: Preserve the evidence and request human classification.

description: A material scope decision requires operator direction.
resolution: Reject until the operator chooses the intended scope.

description: A supported material item was excluded from the Standard COA.
resolution: Retain and visibly disclose the supported exclusion.

description: The required focused coverage review did not complete.
resolution: Reject and rerun when another review turn is available.

description: A populated routed schedule was neither mapped nor explained.
resolution: Map it or name the exact superseding schedule and reason.

description: The Summary OOD and miscellaneous presentation mode is unknown.
resolution: Inspect the Summary and select the supported mode.

description: A repair response reached its output limit.
resolution: Use the best earlier completed validation and disclose truncation.
